mainEntity.name: How much does an Audi Q2 30 TFSI / 1.0 TFSI engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost varies based on the engine's condition, but for the 1.0 TFSI CHZJ/DKRF codes, prices typically range from £500 for a used unit to £1,200-£2,200 for a reconditioned engine, with fully rebuilt units ranging from £2,000 to £3,500.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in an Audi Q2 30 TFSI / 1.0 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cooling system vulnerabilities are a known trait of the EA211 architecture, though rarely catastrophic if monitored. Sweet-smelling coolant odour or visible puddles under the vehicle. Dashboard warnings for low coolant levels or engine overheating. Whining noises from the front of the engine bay indicating bearing wear in the pump.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in an Audi Q2 30 TFSI / 1.0 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for most owners, due to the vehicle's strong retained value and the high cost of equivalent new models.

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service is highly efficient, typically completing the entire process within 2 to 4 working days to minimise your downtime.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the CHZJ and DKRF engine codes in the Audi Q2 30 TFSI / 1.0 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: They represent sequential calibrations of the same 1.0L EA211 turbocharged petrol architecture.

historyTimeline.h2: Audi Q2 30 TFSI / 1.0 TFSI - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the 1.0 TFSI (later badged as 30 TFSI) was introduced to the Q2 range, it offered a highly efficient, turbocharged three-cylinder alternative to the larger 1.4 TFSI, delivering strong urban economy without sacrificing typical Audi refinement.

milestones.description: CHZJ (1.0L TFSI, 116hp) introduced for the Q2 launch, featuring lightweight EA211 architecture for optimal fuel efficiency.
DKRF (1.0L TFSI, 116hp) introduced alongside the "30 TFSI" naming convention update, featuring refined engine management and improved emissions compliance for the facelifted model.
